title: The poorer the country, the more the cost is unpaid family care
unit: % of total dementia cost that is unpaid family care

metadata.note: Informal care = unpaid time given by family and others. In lower-middle-income countries it is about 65% of all dementia cost and formal/residential social care is negligible; the burden is borne inside the household, mostly by women, and never appears in any budget.
